content: Our goal in this work is to streamline the feature engineering phase by not relying on any dictionary other than English word embeddings that are trained on any data (i.e. not necessarily sentiment analysis corpus). To that end, we utilize off-the-shelf machine translation tools to first translate corpora to the language where more training data is available and use the translated corpora to do inference on.
